name: legion-router
description: Legion's multi-model brain: registry-driven routing and scoped delegation across Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Hermes, and Pi. Implemented adapters return a verified, metered diff from an isolated worktree. Ships `legion-delegate`, executor wrappers, generic GitHub issue intake via `legion-intake` (delegate, cursor, or a compatible custom worker), the loopback :8082 metering proxy, shared cost table, and codex-json parser.
